'''2016 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Chris Kelly LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Kelly LS 2016 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
